title: Численность и размещение населения Саратовской области. Итоги Всероссийской переписи населения 2010 года
publisher: Территориальный орган Федеральной службы государственной статистики по Саратовской области
read_scope: Whole frozen machine-text extract of the 107-page primary publication; the complete individual urban/rural NP population table (printed pages26–99) is parsed. Original PDF binary was not obtained or visually inspected. Male/female sums and source-published province totals/counts are checked; two district contexts in reader order fail totals and are explicitly held.
identity_scope: Original2010 typed names unique independently within both full provincial frames. No2021 name/district, population value, desired type or fitted total selects identity. This does not prove intercensus chain identity or unchanged NP boundaries.
known_reader_context_problem: Духовницкий/Екатериновский heading-order issue, including possible displaced Полеводинский570, Тамбовский82 and Грачи0. No row is moved between districts to fit totals.
data_scope: Reported resident population and sex at individual2010 NP grain, not municipal aggregates or service flows.
